subject: Private/VPC architecture review — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Jones <sara.jones@acme.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private/VPC architecture review — next steps

Hi Sara & Tom,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — great overview of your goals for deploying a private instance of Redwood in your VPC. Quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- Summary: You want a VPC-hosted/private control plane with customer-managed networking, KMS integration, and audit log retention for compliance. Primary use cases are customer-facing chat and a batch embedding pipeline for search.
- Open technical items: expected QPS, max sequence lengths (batch jobs), SSO/KMS requirements, and whether you need on-prem options for air-gapped environments.

Next step: schedule a technical architecture review (30–45m) with our Solutions Engineering lead to walk through VPC connectivity patterns, required firewall rules, and a draft network diagram. Dev Patel (SE) would join to cover the low-level details and ops considerations. Vivek and I will be there for commercial/next-step context.

Proposed windows: Mon 5/10 10–11am PT, Tue 5/11 1–2pm PT, or Wed 5/12 9–10am PT. If those don't work, share a few times and we'll align.

I've attached a short Private/VPC overview and our security questionnaire answers to help prep.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0198

Thanks Marissa — appreciated the recap.

We can do Mon 5/10 10:30–11:15am PT if that works for your team. Ben (cc'd) is our infra lead and will join to cover network/firewall constraints.

A few items it'd be great for Dev to be ready to discuss:
- VPC peering vs. PrivateLink patterns and implications for egress/IP whitelisting
- Required ports and CIDR ranges for a dedicated Redwood deployment
- How KMS key wrapping and audit logging integrate with your control plane
- Typical timeline for provisioning a private instance (approx. lead times)

If you can send a lightweight agenda and any diagrams beforehand that'd help Ben prep.

Tom

Perfect — 5/10 10:30–11:15am PT is on our side. I've proposed a calendar invite and included a short agenda below. Dev, Vivek — can you confirm availability?

Agenda (30–45m):
1) Intros & goals (5m)
2) Connectivity patterns: peering vs PrivateLink vs Transit (10m)
3) Network requirements (ports/CIDRs) and KMS integration (10m)
4) Provisioning timeline, SLAs, and next steps (10m)
5) Q&A / action items (5–10m)

I'll upload a one-page network diagram and the security Qs to the shared Drive link so Ben can skim ahead.

Thanks — see you Friday morning.

Marissa

Thanks — I'll be there at 10:30am PT. A couple quick asks so we can prepare the architecture options: 

- Can you confirm whether Acme prefers egress through a NAT in your VPC or whether you require no internet egress (air-gapped)?
- Do you have a preferred KMS provider (AWS KMS, Cloud HSM, or other) and a contact for key provisioning?
- If possible, send a simple diagram of your current VPC/subnet layout (CIDR ranges) or attach a screenshot of your infra diagram.

I'll prepare two pattern diagrams (VPC Peering and PrivateLink) and a short list of required security controls we typically ask customers to allow.

Dev
